title.zh: 矩补偿平移 Maxwell 分布

summary: Build clipped, quadrature-normalized shifted Maxwellian slices and apply the bounded discrete drift/energy compensation stage.

capability: Construct normalized shifted Maxwellian slices with the retained discrete correction stage.
operation: build and compensate shifted Maxwellian slices
vr, vx, temperatures, shifts, species parameters -> [vr,vx,shift] distribution
discovery.model: Clipped exponential shifted Maxwellian followed by the bounded discrete two-moment correction and per-slice renormalization.
discovery.geometry: Two-dimensional normalized cylindrical velocity mesh with one slice per shift.
discovery.boundary: Temperatures at or below zero return zero slices; the exponent uses the strict interior -80 clamp and final normalization uses the caller mesh.

identity.relation: normalized shifted Maxwellian inputs to moment-compensated distribution slices
identity.direction: vr, vx, temperatures_eV, shifts_ms, mu, molecularity, tnorm_eV -> distribution
identity.definition: Compute thermal speed, clipped shifted exponentials, normalize each slice on the cylindrical quadrature, apply compensate_velocity_slice to target drift and energy, and normalize again.
identity.model: Discrete shifted Maxwellian with fixed hydrogen mass/charge constants and source-shaped moment compensation.
identity.geometry: Rows are normalized radial speed vr, columns normalized axial velocity vx, and the third axis indexes shifts.
identity.coordinates: vr/vx use v/vth; shifts are m/s; temperatures and tnorm are eV.
identity.boundary: Nonpositive temperature follows the zero-slice branch; exponent values outside the strict (-80,0) interval are replaced by -80.
assumptions: The velocity mesh is accepted by cylindrical quadrature.
mu and molecularity follow the source mass and molecule-count conventions.
The final normalized distribution is a discrete source object, not a complete transport solution.

inputs.name: mu
inputs.constraints: Used in thermal speed and target energy.

inputs.name: molecularity
inputs.constraints: Used in exponent and target energy.

inputs.name: moment_rtol
inputs.description: Largest accepted relative error of the returned moments

outputs.name: distribution
outputs.units: normalized density per cylindrical velocity volume
outputs.constraints: Each positive-temperature slice is renormalized on the generated quadrature; zero/nonpositive branches return zero slices.

preconditions: The axes and species parameters follow the normalized source conventions.
The caller accepts fixed hydrogen mass/charge constants and clipped exponent arithmetic.
supported: Finite shifted Maxwellian slices for the declared atomic/molecular source-shaped branches.
excluded: ADAS/JH or molecular coupled transport, full solver evolution, external calibration and physical correctness beyond retained fixtures.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Quadrature and array shape/index errors propagate; no alternate mesh or solver is selected. Raises ValueError if a returned slice misses its drift or temperature by more than moment_rtol, or goes negative below -moment_rtol times its peak, which happens when the velocity mesh is too small for the temperature.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Overflow, NaN and warning behavior follows NumPy arithmetic and the retained source-shaped correction.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative solver is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial distribution mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: build_compensated_shifted_maxwellian(*, vr, vx, temperatures_eV, shifts_ms, mu, molecularity, tnorm_eV, moment_rtol=0.01)

example.description: Build three shifts including the zero-temperature branch. The mesh here is deliberately small, so the accepted moment error is widened from its default.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import build_compensated_shifted_maxwellian
vr=np.array([.25,.75,1.5]); vx=np.array([-2.5,-1.5,-.5,.5,1.5,2.5]); out=build_compensated_shifted_maxwellian(vr=vr,vx=vx,temperatures_eV=np.array([5.,0.,-1.]),shifts_ms=np.array([0.,100.,-100.]),mu=1,molecularity=1,tnorm_eV=5., moment_rtol=0.1); assert out.shape==(3,6,3) and np.all(out[:,:,1:]==0)
example.expected: The distribution has shape (3,6,3); zero and negative temperature slices are exactly zero.

scope: Direct shape, zero-temperature branch and finite positive-temperature slice checks.
Retained candidate evidence covers temperature branches, clipping, nonuniform deuterium and NaN/negative/zero edge rows.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded source-fidelity partial for A06; one NaN payload/warning difference, integer/float type differences, independent scientific correctness, ADAS/JH validation, full solver and acceptance remain unresolved.
known_limitations: This extends the existing pre-compensation shifted Maxwellian leaf with a source-shaped correction stage; it does not replace that leaf.
The fixed constants and clipped arithmetic are model conventions, not calibration evidence.
Candidate evidence excludes molecular/coupled branches and complete transport solver parity.
